answers.notes: We are a 22 person engineering consultancy. Four partners bill at $400 an hour with 50% utilisation, twelve staff engineers bill at $190 with 78% utilisation, and we use about 300 contractor hours a month at $160 billed and $100 cost. Retainers make up 45% of revenue with a 10% discount. Realisation is around 91% because of write-offs. Business development is two people. Rent is covered by the office line at about $9,000 a month. We expect rate increases of 4% a year and want to buy a competitor in year three, so we need a valuation-ready five year model.
